description: Defines constants, string conversions, and utility functions related to cookies, including cookie priorities, SameSite attributes, port ranges, and URL schemes within the net namespace.

methods.name: CookiePriorityToString
methods.description: Converts a CookiePriority enum value to its string representation ('high', 'medium', 'low').

methods.name: StringToCookiePriority
methods.description: Converts a string to its corresponding CookiePriority enum value, case-insensitive.

methods.name: CookieSameSiteToString
methods.description: Converts a CookieSameSite enum value to its string representation ('lax', 'strict', 'none', 'extended', 'unspecified').

methods.name: StringToCookieSameSite
methods.description: Parses a string to determine the corresponding CookieSameSite enum value and sets the samesite_string accordingly.

methods.name: RecordCookieSameSiteAttributeValueHistogram
methods.description: Records a histogram metric for the Cookie SameSite attribute value.

methods.name: ReducePortRangeForCookieHistogram
methods.description: Maps a port number to a CookiePort enum value for histogram purposes.

methods.name: GetSchemeNameEnum
methods.description: Determines the CookieSourceSchemeName enum value based on the URL scheme.
